note: Private campground on the Cedar River, 7 miles from Tipton, reached through a housing development and down a long steep drive; call the host on entering. Shore fishing; boat ramp $5 per stay. Open ~Apr 15-Oct 15. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 50 amp, showers, dump on request; sewer at site cleared; first-come added. No nightly rate posted. Riverfront stands on imagery. Flags: long-stay, phone.
flags: GATE FACTS: NO NIGHTLY RATE on the operator's page; it posts only 'Monthly Special 600$ +tax' and 'Monthly 600$ and Annual availability & rates please contact us'. RV Life tier 2 (avg $38); RV Life camper reports $35 (8/2025, 10/2025), $40 (6/2024, 9/2026). Under $50 on every report. GS: not checked as a Good Sam Park in stored data. Gateway: none within 40 km (nearest family home 208 km). Presence: working own site, owner's phone, Google 4.6 (87). RATINGS: Google 4.6 (87); RV Life 3.5 stars on only 5 reviews (ratings out of 10: 2, 6, 10, 10, 10), under the 25-review line so no automatic drop.

LONG-STAY, a human call: the home page advertises nightly and long stays together. Quotes: 'First-come nightly camping', 'Camp Now', 'Monthly Special 600$ +tax', 'Monthly 600$ and Annual availability & rates please contact us', and testimonial 'we have been annual campers for two years now'. RV Life nightly stops at $35-40 from 2024 to 9/2026 ('good for an overnight stay'). No posted nightly rate, which matters under test 2 if you read the park as long-stay; the review record reads to me as a mixed park that really sells nights, so I lean keep. I could not measure the seasonal share: imagery shows RVs in the strip but cannot tell which are annual.

BOOKING COMPLAINT: RV Life 10/2026, rating 2, did not stay: 'Went back on word: I called the owner six months out to book a specific night... He stated to call within the month we would arrive. He stated there was always space. I did call and was told' (text truncated in what I read). Consistent with first-come.
PHONE: stored 563-946-3034; the operator's page and Google give 319-325-1700 (Dean Gates). Should change. Website: keep hiddenrivercampground.com; I did not open the Facebook link.

WATERFRONT: riverfront stands, not re-rated. Imagery shows pads in a strip running roughly 41.6543,-91.1364 to 41.6512,-91.1350 between a drive on the inland side and the Cedar, which is about 200 m wide there; a bare bank and thin tree line between pads and water, no road between. Reviews agree ('right on river', 'overlooking the Cedar River'). Pin ~100 m inland of the strip, OK; could go to about 41.6525,-91.1358. Not every pad is river-row: the north end has a clearing set back behind trees.

NOTE: dropped the note's 'beach', which I did not find on the operator's page; 'Open ~Apr 15-Oct 15' kept though the page says only 'OPEN' and no dates. Reviews warn of the drive: 'down a steep hill so be careful if raining', 'downhill driveway be ready'; a 41-ft fifth wheel fit, so 23 ft is fine. RV Life reviews: water yes, sewer no.
